item_data.name: Custom Therapeutic Massage
item_data.description: Your therapist adjusts pressure and techniques to your goals and tolerance. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing massage (Swedish) or deep tissue, our massages are therapeutic and customized to your needs. Effective work does not need to feel painful. Choose 30 minutes for one focused area, 60 minutes for a focused or broader session, and 90 or 120 minutes for more comprehensive work with extra time for your priorities. Tell us what feels tight or restricted, and we will tailor the session around you.
